proof.text: Paste the scalar pullback square through fixedRestriction, the equivalence from constant-ring module sheaves to sheaves of modules over the constant coefficient ring. The comparison resFixed identifies this square with the standard upperStar scalar square. Its inverse open mate is the invertible lower-shriek scalar model, scalarOpenModel_isIso. The two fixed-coordinate inverse mates are isomorphisms because their horizontal edges are equivalences. Inverse-mate composition and cancellation of the equivalence edge therefore show openResMap is invertible. scalarJInv is this same map by definition; hence each component is invertible. The argument uses arbitrary coefficient rings, including the zero ring, and empty opens, without any Finite instance.

title: Componentwise invertibility of the scalar open mate
statement: For every coefficient homomorphism, open immersion and module object, the component of scalarJInv is an isomorphism.
